scope: Read-only manifest inventory and process samples for the retained PLY-3 reopen failure

profile.method: Preexisting project and Chromium local file picker; sampled owned processes before import and attempted another sample after import.
profile.afterImportSampler: Failed with exit code 0x80131623; no post-import snapshot was captured by that sampler.
profile.outcome: Guarded lease expired; owned processes were terminated and cleanup was confirmed.

limitations: The process sampler itself ran in the guarded job and could affect memory and timing.
The external sample was taken after the sampler failed and does not identify which allocations remained live or why threads were suspended.
The manifest records stored bytes, not live object ownership or peak memory. No production fix or post-reopen validation is established.
